title: US SEC filing: Vanguard marks down Ola Consumer's valuation to ~$70.3M; Ola, which faces intense competition from Uber and Rapido, was valued at $7.3B in 2021 (Kunal Manchanada/Entrackr)
summary: Kunal Manchanada / Entrackr: US SEC filing: Vanguard marks down Ola Consumer's valuation to ~$70.3M; Ola, which faces intense competition from Uber and Rapido, was valued at $7.3B in 2021 — US-based asset management firm Vanguard has sharply marked down the valuation of ride-hailing company Ola Cosumer to approximately $70.3 million …
